public class A: Codable {
    public var b: B?

    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case b = "b"
    }

    public init(b: B?) {
        self.b = b
    }

    public required init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        self.b = try container.decodeIfPresent(B.self, forKey: .b)
    }
}

public class B: Codable {
    public var a: A?

    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case a = "a"
    }

    public init(a: A?) {
        self.a = a
    }

    public required init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        self.a = try container.decodeIfPresent(A.self, forKey: .a)
    }
}

public class TreeNode: Codable {
    public var children: [TreeNode]?
    public var value: String

    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case children = "children"
        case value = "value"
    }

    public init(children: [TreeNode]?, value: String) {
        self.children = children
        self.value = value
    }

    public required init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        self.children = try container.decodeIfPresent([TreeNode].self, forKey: .children)
        self.value = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .value)
    }
}
